cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.

mechanism: A manages a repair report and gives up its oral presentation while requiring written roof credit and a dated record of promised thanks.
confusable: Unlike seeking present praise alone, A wants durable credit and a pending acknowledgment that cannot disappear after the party.
comparison: Village minutes and promised public thanks differ from task-specific credit on a framed prize.
seedUse: D177-a Pat roof repair, minutes and thanks pending; S02-a shortens the report while preserving the record.
